branch-core.js: Branch-safe scan operation registry, lineage comparison, branch snapshots and the user's dismissed-NPC groups.
core-mechanics.js: Gathers Delta's core text, identity, record, portrait, prompt and merge parts into one import point.
core.js: The core entry: re-exports the mechanics, appearance, lifecycle and calendar parts and holds story-day, stale-NPC and NPC record normalizing.
destructive-settlement.js: Browser-side registry that connects the destructive-settlement controller to SillyTavern and Delta's public API.
hardening-core.js: Pure settings-key rules for chat and character ownership moves, renames and lifecycle deletes.
hardening.js: Applies the settings-key hardening rules in the browser: owner-qualified keys, renames and deleted chats.
identity.js: Encodes, decodes and compares the owner-qualified chat keys that Delta files are stored under.
scripts/browser-stage9.py: Optional synthetic browser checks of the local UI modules using Playwright and an in-memory host.
scripts/measure-prompts.mjs: Builds Delta's scanner, profile, injection and narration prompts for fixed scenes and checks their sizes, without provider calls.
scripts/package.mjs: Runs package.py with a Python it finds, to produce and verify the installable package.
scripts/package.py: Produces and verifies a deterministic runtime-only installable package of Delta.
scripts/validate.mjs: Validates Delta's manifest, module list and source files for the package check.
